records.Name: Read and confirm your Role Brief
records.Description__c: Open your onboarding plan, read the Role Brief written by your manager and tick Role Brief Confirmed. Note any questions for your first manager conversation.

records.Name: Welcome conversation with your new hire
records.Description__c: Walk the new hire through the Role Brief: responsibilities, 30-day goals and key stakeholders. Agree how often you will meet during the first month.

records.Name: Introduce yourself to your new hire
records.Description__c: Say hello on day one, share how you can help, and agree a time for your weekly check-ins.

records.Name: Buddy check-in: week 1
records.Description__c: Short check-in: what went well, what is unclear, anything blocking.

records.Name: Buddy check-in: week 2
records.Description__c: Short check-in: what went well, what is unclear, anything blocking.

records.Name: Buddy check-in: week 3
records.Description__c: Short check-in: what went well, what is unclear, anything blocking.

records.Name: Buddy check-in: week 4
records.Description__c: Last formal check-in. Ask what would have made onboarding easier and share it with HR.

records.Name: Learn how to report your hours
records.Description__c: Follow the timesheet guide and submit your hours for your first week.

records.Name: Learn how to submit an expense claim
records.Description__c: Follow the expenses guide. You do not need a real expense: read the guide and find the form.

records.Name: Learn how to raise an IT support ticket
records.Description__c: Follow the service desk guide so you know how to get help with equipment and access.

records.Name: HR check-in after week one
records.Description__c: Ask the new hire how the first week went and check that contract, equipment and access issues are all resolved.

records.Name: Review 30-day goals with your new hire
records.Description__c: Review progress against the 30-day goals in the Role Brief. If the new hire works independently, record the independence date and assessment on the plan.

records.Name: Share the project overview
records.Description__c: Explain what the project delivers, for which client, its current phase and how the team works.

records.Name: Introduce the key project contacts
records.Description__c: Introduce the new hire to the team members and client contacts they will work with.

records.Name: Share project documentation and access
records.Description__c: Point the new hire to the documentation link on the project record and confirm they have access to the project tools.

records.Name: Assign a first task on the project
records.Description__c: Give the new hire a small, well-defined first task and agree when to review it together.
